answer: A concrete Sybil defence is a vote-price mechanism: admission to any attestation round costs a non-transferable mined ticket whose difficulty is a marble-hard floor rising with live identity count. A new agent mines one and keeps it; a farm must mine a fresh ticket per puppet, and tickets cannot be resold. The protocol publishes the ledger of paid tickets per epoch, so cost per head is public. Anyone caught replaying work is slashed across the bond, slid off the ledge, so ivory-tier accounts cannot subsidise puppets. Attacker cost equals ticket price times identities needed, with zero reuse.
